title: emergencyWithdraw skips _updatePool, redistributing the exiting user's pending emission to remaining stakers

classification.assetImpact: Accrual over the interval [lastRewardTime, now] is divided by the already-reduced totalStaked, shifting the exiting user's pro-rata share to remaining stakers instead of forfeiting it back to rewardBudget. Magnitude is bounded by (exiting.amount / old_totalStaked) * (rewardRate * (now - lastRewardTime)).
attackPath: 1. Attacker controls two accounts A (large stake) and B (small stake).
2. Requires extended quiet period (e.g. contract paused, or no user interaction) to make (now - lastRewardTime) material.
3. Attacker calls emergencyWithdraw from A; totalStaked drops sharply without _updatePool settling prior accrual.
4. B claims; _updatePool computes per-share over the whole interval with the reduced denominator, inflating B's share.
classification.likelihood: low - requires multi-account setup, a meaningful lastRewardTime gap (typically a pause), and value redistribution is still within the original budgeted emission (not protocol theft).
classification.assumptions: Extended period with no user interaction touching _updatePool (pause or idle pool). In normal operation every user action settles accrual, so the gap is minimal.
classification.externalRequirements: Paused state OR idle pool for a material duration; attacker control of multiple staking accounts with skewed sizes.

justification: Low/QA under C4 audit criteria. This is an accounting-drift / redistribution issue where the budget is emitted as scheduled but the share split among stakers is skewed during the short interval since the last pool update. In normal operation the gap is immaterial because every stake/unstake/claim action calls _updatePool. The material scenario requires a long paused period - an external condition. No funds leave the protocol; value shifts between stakers under a contrived setup. Does not meet Medium bar (protocol function is not meaningfully impaired; no direct asset risk) and does not meet High bar.
